text:
Your thoughts are quietly killing your future.

Your brain moves toward whatever fills it most. Rich thoughts build rich habits. Poor thoughts build poor ones.

Call it the poverty loop. You feed your brain failure without thinking, and it quietly runs your choices for you.

The fix:

1. Audit your feed. What goes in first and last each day.
2. Cut it. 3 minutes max of content that makes you feel small or stuck.
3. Replace it. 10 minutes a day on men who built what you want.

Think broke. Be broke. It works the other way too.
caption:
Self improvement isn't about grinding harder. It's about what you feed your mindset. Men who win the discipline game start with their mental diet, not their schedule.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
